source_review.notes: Reviewed primary CHESS, iterative context bounding, DPOR, linearizability, CDSChecker, PCT and logical-clock sources plus current project-owned Coyote, Loom and GenMC documentation. Search completeness, replay, weak-memory and tool-scope limitations are retained.

evidence: State, enabled-transition, successor, schedule, bound, dependence, hash and property notation are distinct.
Relative completeness is explicitly parameterized by semantics, initial state, bounds and sound reduction.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Checked finite-state/search terminology and claim quantifiers.

evidence: Enumerated all 6 order-preserving schedules for two actors with two transitions each.
Recomputed final-state counts: 4 schedules yield one and 2 yield two.
Recomputed Exercise 1 as 5!/(3!*2!)=10 and snippet passed exact stdout.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts describe the stated SC microstep model only.

evidence: Verified the multinomial interleaving formula (sum ni)!/product(ni!) under actor-local order.
Checked that enabledness plus step semantics constructs only legal modeled traces.
Checked that POR equivalence requires both commuting successors and preserved enabledness/property observations.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No unbounded completeness or weak-memory result is inferred from SC enumeration.

evidence: Reviewed hidden native threads, callbacks, timers, randomness, I/O, devices, foreign runtimes and escaping side effects.
Reviewed zero/shallow bounds, cutoff, expected quiescence, unfair cycles, hash omission/collision, unsound reduction and replay divergence.
Reviewed relaxed atomics, cancellation/fault positions, model fidelity, artifact sensitivity, railway control and infusion-pump transfer.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Covers semantic, search, operational, security and high-stakes boundaries.

evidence: Every nondeterministic source maps to a controlled transition or explicit unsupported entry.
Scheduler choices must be enabled; state projection and dependence retain all property-relevant effects.
Trace identity, completed bounds, frontier states, property assumptions and unsupported surfaces remain immutable evidence.
invariant_checking.notes: Checked the evidence chain from model inventory through bounded claim.

evidence: Model/control, exploration, property, replay/minimization and claim-boundary obligations are separately stated.
Safety counterexamples are distinguished from bounded liveness and fairness-dependent cycle reasoning.
Weak-memory evidence is delegated to a checker with documented language semantics rather than inferred from SC schedules.
proof_review.notes: No testing result is represented as universal formal verification.

evidence: The executable example disclaims native instructions, compiler transformations, weak memory and scheduler completeness.
Relative completeness and bounded-liveness claims name their assumptions.
Railway and infusion-pump cases name required reviewers and explicitly claim none.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Certification, clinical efficacy and deployment authorization remain external.

evidence: Executable Python schedule enumeration reproduced exact expected output with zero exit status.
Operational evidence requires build/model/input digests, search strategy, bounds, counts, traces, replay and cutoffs.
CI guidance separates per-change bounded searches, periodic deep/fault/platform searches, sanitizers and production-like integration.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No Coyote, Loom, GenMC, railway or medical-device execution is claimed.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed transition-system model, deterministic environment, schedule enumeration, search bounds, DPOR/state hashing, safety/linearizability/liveness oracles, replay, weak memory, CI and high-stakes limits.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed reset/isolation, logical time, environment seams, stable event IDs, immutable digests, divergence handling, fault alphabets, frontier accounting, sharding, artifact retention, sanitizer compatibility, model-fidelity checks and unsupported-operation gates.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter progresses from a six-schedule executable example to control boundaries, reductions, liveness and production evidence; counters eighteen misconceptions; supplies ten examples through railway interlocking; and includes five complete exercises ending in infusion-pump transfer.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner and pedagogical evidence only; no external CHESS/Coyote/Loom/GenMC/CDSChecker author, programming-language/runtime/toolchain, formal-methods, distributed-systems, real application, railway signaling, infusion-pump/clinical, functional-safety, cybersecurity/privacy, operations, quality/regulatory, ethics, accessibility/human-factors or independent validation review is claimed. The chapter and example prove neither implementation-wide schedule completeness, weak-memory correctness, unbounded liveness, model fidelity, production correctness, performance, portability, certification, clinical efficacy, approval nor deployment safety.
